messages.text: Hi, I sent the duvet set back over a week ago. Why haven't I got my refund yet?

messages.text: I can see one duvet set in order h12-o1, but it isn’t marked as received back yet, so there’s no refund request showing. Could you check whether it has been delivered back to the shop?
I did send it back eight days ago with tracking, but the tracking only says it was handed over to the carrier. There haven’t been any updates since.

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"refund returned parcel sent by customer, carrier tracking shows handed over but no further updates, when refund can be processed and whether human review is required"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/amount", "title": "Refund amount", "text": "The refund for a unit is what was paid for that unit: its price minus its share of any discount. The shares are fixed once, when the order is recorded, and never recalculated: when a paid total is split among identical units, each unit gets the total divided by the number of units, rounded down to the smallest unit of the currency, and what is left over is added one smallest unit at a time to the last units, so no unit is refunded more than its price. Shipping charges are not part of the amount."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payment", "title": "Where the money goes", "text": "A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one payment record and that record is valid (a known payment method and a positive amount), and only to that payment. Instalments of one payment are one payment record. In every other case a staff member takes the case. A refund can never be sent to another person, account or card."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text: Because the shop’s records don’t yet show the duvet set as received, I can’t start a refund. Since you’ve sent it back, a staff member needs to check the return (refund-policy/v1/return). A person will take over and follow up with you.
